h1: We also develop and build capacity.
lede: Purview develops hyperscale capacity itself: originating power-secured sites, structuring bankable projects and building AI-ready campuses in the UK and India, with a 300 MW+ development pipeline.

items.label: AI growth corridors and Indian states

blocks.text: Middle East. End-to-end delivery of a regional AI facility for an AI cloud operator: GPU-dense halls, high-density power distribution, advanced cooling, full design, build and commissioning.
Telangana, India. Build-to-suit hyperscale campus backed by a bonded AI logistics hub (GigaPort).
Scotland, UK. Consented site with grid energisation scheduled for 2028, within the Scottish AI Growth Zone.
India. Sovereign state data centres, HPC estates and security operations centres in production.
Grid connection is the main constraint of the AI era. Purview controls sites with secured power and consents in UK AI growth corridors and Indian states, then builds and operates them.
